# Mail (cms-api)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`access-admin`](../../flows/access-admin/FLOW.md), [`password`](../../flows/password/FLOW.md), [`two-factor-setup`](../../flows/two-factor-setup/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Sends the one-time codes and invitations. `MAIL_PROVIDER` picks the adapter: `smtp` in production, `console` for development (rejected in production because it logs the codes, D17).

## Techniques

Port plus a factory table keyed by provider, so a new provider must add a factory. Plain text only, no HTML and no links. SMTP socket timeouts are bounded (nodemailer's defaults are minutes).

## Technologies

nodemailer (any SMTP submission server; Mailpit in dev and smoke).

## Entry points

`MAIL_SENDER`, `MailSender`, `MailMessage`, `MailModule`.

## Where to change what

A new provider: a value in the config's `MAIL_PROVIDERS`, an adapter here and an entry in `MAIL_SENDER_FACTORIES`. Timeouts: `Mail.constants.ts`.
